definition: Close every open position of the unit once their combined open result reaches profit in account money.
boundaries: It reads all the unit's open positions together, which no host passes an exit yet, so it has no code. Grid and averaging units use it to close a basket whose single trades are each at a loss. Which exits and halts a unit may use, and their numbers, are the risk session's call (ledger R-04); this entry says what the rule does, not whether to use it.
recognition: When the whole basket is up a set amount, every position closes at once.

sources.quote: Close all open positions if the overall profit reaches a specified sum in $.
